say:1:1060000401:0.text: Magister, trail behind the mana sprites and lead them back to where they came from! This way, they won't attack us!
say:1:1060000401:0.source_cn: 主人，我们只要跟在魔花种子身后，就能把它们赶回花丛里了...
say:1:1060000401:0.male: Magister, trail behind the mana sprites and lead them back to where they came from! This way, they won't attack us!
say:1:1060000401:0.female: Magister, trail behind the mana sprites and lead them back to where they came from! This way, they won't attack us!

say:4:1060000402:0.text: Oops, we took the wrong path! Magister, let's go back and ask the mana sprites where their home is!
say:4:1060000402:0.source_cn: ……不对，我们走错路了！主人，我们回去问问魔花种子的家...
